reviewer: Claude stored caption and figure comparison at reduced size; not a radiologist review
rule: A stored figure is bound to a structure when a sentence of its published caption or stored source note names the structure, the sentence is about a selected panel, the fidelity checker finds no modality or side conflict, and the figure was looked at. A figure whose record states no side may support a left or right requirement (side rule relaxed by the project owner on 2026-11-17): the side the sentence states, or each side when it states none and the two sides are mirror images.
method: Requirement names were matched against stored descriptions with filler words removed, and again by the parts of compound names. About 630 candidate pairs were read. Each accepted figure was looked at on a contact sheet.

side_values.caption_states_side: the record states no side; the quoted sentence states this side or both sides
side_values.side_not_stated: the record and the sentence state no side; bound on the mirror-image assumption
side_values.record_states_side: the figure record itself states the matching side
side_values.not_sided: the requirement has no left or right side

findings_not_bound.reason: Requirements that are findings or diagnoses (haematoma, fracture, thrombus, stenosis and so on) are not bound in this pass; whether a figure of a finding should support a finding requirement is a separate decision.
